landscape.label: Rules to Know
landscape.title: Beverly Hills ADU rules to know

tiles.s: Junior ADUs stay inside the house

landscape.speak: A few rules to know. A city has sixty days to act on a complete application. A junior ADU tops out at five hundred square feet. ADUs of seven hundred fifty square feet or less skip impact fees. And Beverly Hills allows up to four units on a single-family lot.
landscape.say: A few rules to know. A city has 60 days to act on a complete application. A junior ADU tops out at 500 square feet. ADUs of 750 square feet or less skip impact fees. And Beverly Hills allows up to four units on a single-family lot.
